messages:
maria_privsec: Heads up — DSAR delete job failed for requester 0b9c after last night's KMS key rotation. Worker log shows `AccessDenied` on key alias `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/dsar/cryptoKeys/redwood-dsar`. Suspect RBAC tweak from Friday might have removed the service account.
ashwin_eng: Can you paste the exact log lines?
maria_privsec: ```
2026-03-12T03:12:09Z dsar-delete-worker ERROR DecryptError: AccessDenied: projects/.../cryptoKeys/redwood-dsar: caller does not have permission
requester=0b9c job_id=dsar-delete-9012
```
samir_ops: I'm oncall — looking. Which service account runs the delete job?
maria_privsec: `sa-dsar-delete@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
samir_ops: Likely lost `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the new key version. We tightened key bindings in the RBAC cleanup last week — maybe that removed the SA.
jlee_legal: Legal has a follow-up from the requester asking for ETA. If we can't complete erasure within SLA, we need to document retention exception and notify.
ashwin_eng: Quick triage steps: (1) confirm alias points to rotated key version, (2) check key IAM policy, (3) run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ...` to see members.
maria_privsec: Confirmed alias -> keyVersion 3 (rotated). Key IAM bindings do not include `sa-dsar-delete`. There is a binding to `role: roles/cloudkms.viewer` for infra accounts only. Also the snapshot metadata for requester 0b9c has `retention_hold=true` flagged by the archival pipeline.
samir_ops: Temp mitigation plan: re-grant `sa-dsar-delete` the `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on that cryptoKey for 1 hour, re-run delete job, capture audit logs, then remove binding. Need legal signoff for emergency change.
jlee_legal: Approve emergency IAM change for 1h strictly to satisfy DSAR erasure. Please record justification: "DSAR pending; unable to decrypt existing snapshots due to KMS rotation; emergency access to complete subject erasure." Include DSAR id and requester identity in audit.
maria_privsec: Agreed. Audit metadata to attach: `dsar_id=0b9c`, `retention_exception=false`, `performed_by=samir_ops`, `approval=jlee_legal`.
samir_ops: Applying binding now (will tag change with the approval note).
security-bot: Incident INC-4821 created by maria_privsec. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/4821
samir_ops: Retry running dsar-delete job...
ashwin_eng: If it still fails, we may need to rewrap snapshots with the new key or add a fallback decryption path via the legacy key, but that requires more approvals.
samir_ops: Delete job succeeded: "erasure completed for requester 0b9c; snapshots purged." Captured audit entry: `kms:decrypt` by `sa-dsar-delete` on `redwood-dsar` at 2026-03-12T03:22:01Z. Removing temporary binding now.
jlee_legal: Thanks. Please package the audit proof (IAM change record, KMS audit entry, delete job output) and share to Legal. We'll close once verified.
maria_privsec: Follow-ups (action items): 1) update KMS onboarding docs to include DSAR service accounts and rotation test; owner: ashwin_eng. 2) add e2e DSAR test covering KMS key rotation (failover path); owner: ashwin_eng. 3) propose a non-interactive rewrap/re-encrypt flow for long-lived snapshots to prevent manual ops on rotation; owner: samir_ops. 4) add monitoring alert for KMS policy drift for keys used by DSAR pipeline.
ashwin_eng: I'll open tickets for 1+2 and include runbook steps.
samir_ops: I'll own 3+4 and draft the monitoring rule (alert if key IAM loses required service accounts).
maria_privsec: Thanks everyone. Notifying product and support for customer communication. Closing thread once proof bundle is uploaded to the incident.
security-bot: Incident INC-4821 status updated: Resolved (mitigated) by samir_ops. Evidence link: https://incidents.redwood/4821/evidence
